picks.name: Intellitronic
picks.source_note: New artist discovery on Rubadub. Heinrich Mueller's (Drexciya/Arpanet/Dopplereffekt) machine-funk project.
picks.bio: "Pixel" (October 6, 2026, Rubadub) is the first full release of lost Intellitronic transmissions from Heinrich Mueller -- four tracks (Pixel, Stencil, Inkjet, Hex Colour Code) of early-90s-style machine funk.
picks.why_listen: Raw, hardware-driven electro from a legendary Drexciya-affiliated producer -- stark, rhythmic material for a driving stretch.

picks.name: Christian Löffler
picks.source_note: New artist discovery. Anniversary B-sides collection, out today.
picks.bio: "Mare (B-Sides)" (October 7, 2026) is a ten-years-later anniversary edition of his breakthrough album Mare -- seven previously unreleased tracks from the same sessions, spanning ambient, deep house and techno.
picks.why_listen: Melodic, emotionally rich production with real range -- useful for both atmospheric and deep-house stretches of a set.
